channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Funding boost for free school meals in Wales to raise help offered to pupils
item.description: Wales will invest an additional £8 million over the next two years in universal free primary school meals, it has been announced.

item.title: Senedd backs Tobacco and Vapes Bill to protect future generation
item.description: Wales has taken a significant step towards a smoke-free future by backing a historic bill to curb youth vaping and end tobacco product purchases by people born on or after January 1, 2009.

item.title: 'Our hearts are breaking' - Author Sophie Kinsella dies aged 55, her family confirms
item.description: Author Sophie Kinsella (Madeleine Sophie Wickham) known for her bestselling Shopaholic book series, has died at the age of 55

item.title: Comedian Kiri Pritchard‑McLean plants Denbigh Plum tree in touching tribute to dad
item.description: “Dad grew up in Denbigh and was often a bit of a plum,” Kiri joked, adding that the tree’s rich history mirrors her father’s love of storytelling.

item.title: Llandudno Junction man charged after exposing himself in supermarket car park
item.description: A man has been charged after exposing himself in a supermarket car park in Llandudno Junction.

item.title: Person in hospital with 'serious' injuries after being hit by car in Llandudno
item.description: A pedestrian is in hospital with "serious" injuries after being hit by a car in Llandudno yesterday (December 9).

item.title: Former Welsh Government site in Rhos-on-Sea could be demolished for homes
item.description: Former Welsh Government buildings in Rhos-on-Sea could be demolished to make way for "affordable" apartments.

item.title: Morrisons confirms axing of Christmas staple from cafes after more than 20 years
item.description: Morrisons has confirmed it is not offering its Christmas dinner in cafes for 2025.

item.title: Chief Constable to retire for a single day to protect pension
item.description: The Chief Constable of North Wales Police has asked to retire for a single day in January before being reappointed to her role – to protect her pension.

item.title: North Wales PCC helping shape future of role after Wales forgotten by Westminster
item.description: After Westminster abolished Police and Crime Commissioners without a clear plan to replace them in Wales, North Wales PCC Andy Dunbobbin is working with fellow Welsh PCCs on a succession plan.
